title: ng-surveillance pipeline parameters
description: Whole-genome sequencing pipeline: QC, assembly, typing, AMR detection, phylogenetics.

input.description: Directory of paired-end FASTQ files, named <sample>_R1_001.fastq.gz / <sample>_R2_001.fastq.gz.

batch_name.description: Label used in output paths and reports. Defaults to the Nextflow run name if not set; set it explicitly for stable, comparable output directories across runs.

organism_specific_options.title: Organism-specific options
organism_specific_options.description: Values tied to the target organism. Change these to adapt the pipeline to a different species.

target_genus_taxid.description: NCBI taxid for the target genus, used to summarise Kraken2 results.

target_species_taxid.description: NCBI taxid for the target species, used to summarise Kraken2 results.

qc_control_sample_pattern.description: Regex matching control-sample IDs, used to exclude them from batch-relative QC flagging.

prokka_genus.description: Genus passed to Prokka's --genus flag. Leave unset to omit --genus entirely.

reference_databases.title: Reference databases
reference_databases.description: External databases. Each stage is skipped with a warning if its database isn't set.

ariba_db.description: Prepared ARIBA database, as a .tar.gz archive.

snippy_reference.description: Reference genome FASTA for reference-mapped Snippy. Needs a BWA index alongside it (.amb .ann .bwt .pac .sa).

snippy_mask.description: BED file of regions to mask (repeats, phage, high SNP density) before building the core-genome alignment.

min_contig_length.description: Minimum contig length kept after assembly.

use_reassembly_for.description: Sample IDs whose reassembly output should be used downstream instead of the original assembly. Empty by default.

pyngost_exclude_samples.description: Comma-separated sample IDs to exclude from batch-wide pyngoST typing.

snippy_core_exclude_samples.description: Comma-separated non-control sample IDs to exclude from batch-wide Snippy-core.

run_phylogeny.description: Run Gubbins recombination masking on the Snippy-core alignment.

run_assembly_mapped_snippy.description: Run the assembly-mapped Snippy branch (each sample mapped to its own assembly). Heterozygous-site QC for this branch isn't built yet, so only variant calling runs.
